findings.finding: The warm cooking-lid idea fitted the brief, but its intent was spread across competing studies.
findings.correction: Keep the chosen wordmark and define the emotional target as welcoming and appetising.
findings.status: Documented; a full founder strategy workshop has not been conducted.

findings.finding: Three multi-colour routes and several single-colour studies were presented without a stable everyday palette.
findings.correction: Use two logo inks: chilli for letters and saffron for lid/rice. Keep dark neutrals for supporting copy.
findings.status: Targets specified; generated pixels are approximate.

findings.finding: BIRYANI was the large second line and ODISHA was a tiny location label. That represented the wrong brand.
findings.correction: Remove BIRYANI from the logo; make ODISHA a prominent part of Dum E Odisha. Add a separate tagline version.
findings.status: Corrected name and tagline checked visually in the delivered images.

findings.finding: No consistent graphic device existed; adding decorative motifs would introduce noise.
findings.correction: Use clean fields and the selected lid/rice idea. Do not invent folk patterns, extra spices or texture.
findings.status: Deliberate restraint; no separate pattern library is delivered.

findings.finding: The name hierarchy was wrong; the guide read mainly as an equal-weight card gallery.
findings.correction: Prioritise the complete name, then tagline. Use measured rule panels, a table of contents and actual supporting type samples.
findings.status: Guide rebuilt; generated logo lettering is not a named or licensed typeface.

findings.finding: Only isolated logo renders were available; applications did not demonstrate the correct name.
findings.correction: Provide a compact identity canvas with food-container and carry-bag studies.
findings.status: Illustrative proof of use, not production packaging artwork.

findings.finding: The full wordmark cannot be read as a 16 px favicon. The first new profile attempt added an unrequested pepper.
findings.correction: Reject the drift; reuse the cleaned tagline-free core file for the profile. Do not claim a 16 px icon.
findings.status: Small favicon remains out of scope; profile requires actual-size checking.

findings.finding: Earlier assets carried the wrong name into every touchpoint.
findings.correction: Only corrected Dum E Odisha files are linked in the current download. Older names are labelled superseded in history.
findings.status: Current asset links and package contents validated.

findings.finding: Old and current studies coexisted without enough separation between rules, proposals and history.
findings.correction: Create one current guide, linked audit and clearly labelled archive. Record fixed colour roles, naming, voice and delivery limits.
findings.status: Current content and file references checked; historical source images retained.

skills.application: Named variants and application rules replace a set of equally ranked colour experiments.

skills.application: Full-name hierarchy repaired; distinctiveness remains unscored without a confirmed direct competitor set.

skills.application: One identity record, named asset manifest and an explicit current-versus-history split.

skills.application: Nano Banana reference-based refinement; clear-space, positive/negative, small-use and application panels.
